verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents a job-board feed: an XML file generated per job board that lists all currently published jobs, so one posting can reach multiple boards. The evidence never names LinkedIn, Indeed or specific aggregators, and nothing shows sponsored or paid post management inside the ATS. Missing for 10: named LinkedIn/Indeed/aggregator integrations, in-ATS sponsored post management (budgets, promotion, performance), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the multiposting flow.
